context: Ren interviews an expert on global concerns.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: expert interview; vocabulary (各国/懸念/激しい/幅/源) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 各国の懸念は、何が中心ですか?
lines.en: What's at the center of nations' concerns?
lines.style: engaged young interviewer voice, soft warm curious focus throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 気候の変化が、懸念の源です。
lines.en: Climate change is the source of concern.
lines.style: composed researcher voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 影響の幅は、広いんですか?
lines.en: Is the range of impact wide?
lines.style: curious young interviewer voice, soft warm focus throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 幅は非常に広く、各国に及びます。
lines.en: The range is very wide, reaching all nations.
lines.style: patient researcher voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 議論は、激しいんですか?
lines.style: engaged young interviewer voice, soft warm focus throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、激しい議論が続いています。
lines.style: composed researcher voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 懸念の源を、断てますか?
lines.en: Can we cut off the source of concern?
lines.style: thoughtful young interviewer voice, soft warm focus throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 各国の協力が、源を減らします。
lines.style: warm researcher voice, soft warm measured closing clarity throughout
